content.short: Decurity is an ABI decompiler for recovering EVM smart contract ABI.
content.description: Decurity is an ABI decompiler that reconstructs the ABI of EVM smart contracts, including function names, to support thorough analysis and verification. Users and developers can use Decurity to audit their contracts, verify their documentation and white papers, and manage vulnerabilities across their protocols. A number of case studies illustrate how the services are applied in practice, helping teams understand workflows from decompilation to security assessments, risk evaluation, and governance decisions.
